claims.text: Treat metabolic acidosis to serum bicarbonate > 18 mmol/L, to slow muscle wasting, bone loss and CKD progression.
claims.quote: Metabolic acidosis should be treated to bring serum bicarbonate to > 18 mmol/L to help reverse or slow muscle wasting, bone loss, and progression of CKD

claims.text: Sodium bicarbonate 1-2 g orally twice a day, increased gradually until bicarbonate > 18 mmol/L or sodium overload prevents more.
claims.quote: Sodium bicarbonate 1 to 2 g orally twice a day is given and the amount is increased gradually until bicarbonate concentration is > 18 mmol/L or until evidence of sodium overloading prevents further therapy
